answer: An identity earns its seat through proof of unique herbalist accreditation with herbal medicine association attestation, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 779 aliases would need 779 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the timber of the check, count the canyon of the cost, and read the lantern of the history before any answer is graded. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
